from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class SearchResultsOutputModel(BaseModel):
    search_results: List[Dict] = Field(default=None, description="List of search results.")
    query_summary: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Response to customer.")
    model_config = Field(default=None, description="ConfigDict", extra="forbid")

    city="San Jose",
    neighborhood=["Downtown"],
    stars=[2],
    has_business_center=True,
    gym_present=True
)

# Search for historical attractions in San Jose

    city="San Jose",
    type=["Historical"]
)

# Find the nearest historical attractions to the hotels
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotel_results,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="attraction"
)
